courses.overview: 由外接連續光源、光分配與可維修性延伸到不同工法，保留物理關係並重新界定系統邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Extend external CW sources, optical distribution and serviceability to related methods while retaining physical relationships and redefining system boundaries.

related.title: 共封裝光學交換器整合
related.why: 兩課都要把光源、熱和維修介面納入 CPO 系統。
related.whyEn: Both include source, heat and service interfaces in CPO systems.
related.transfer: 兩課都要把光源、熱和維修介面納入 CPO 系統。
related.transferEn: Both include source, heat and service interfaces in CPO systems.
related.difference: 外接光源課聚焦光分配與交換；CPO 還須共同配置 ASIC 與短電介面。
related.differenceEn: External-source study emphasizes distribution and replacement; CPO also places the ASIC and short electrical interfaces.
practice: 比較移除一個光源與一個光引擎的失效域。
在兩課中各選一個能推翻結論的量測。
標出交接時不能直接沿用的材料參數或控制條件。
practiceEn: Compare failure domains for removing one source versus one engine.
Choose one falsifying measurement in each course.
Identify material parameters or control conditions that cannot be transferred unchanged.

courses.summary: 外接光源光引擎以外接連續光源、光分配與可維修性連結元件物理與系統驗證。此代表地點用於認識研究與封裝供應鏈；課程由多個公開來源交叉編寫。
courses.summaryEn: External-laser optical engines links device physics and system validation through external CW sources, optical distribution and serviceability. This representative location illustrates the research and packaging ecosystem; the curriculum draws on several public sources.
courses.connection: 以外接連續光源、光分配與可維修性比較相關工法；重新核對材料、波段、控制拓撲與驗收門檻。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related methods through external CW sources, optical distribution and serviceability, rechecking materials, wavelength, control topology and acceptance limits.

history.title: ELSFP 2.0 介面文件發布
history.text: OIF 的「ELSFP 2.0 外接雷射實作協議」提供可追溯的發展案例。它支援本課的原理與設計問題；課程算例另行設定，並不冒充該研究的性能。研究事件與地圖的封裝代表據點分開標示，不主張兩者發生在同一地點。
history.textEn: OIF: ELSFP 2.0 external-laser implementation agreement provides a traceable development example. It informs the principles and design questions; course calculations use separate assumptions and do not claim that study's performance. The research event and the representative packaging location are distinct and are not claimed to share a site.

history.title: 從單元件指標到可測試系統
history.titleEn: From component metrics to testable systems
history.text: 本課把外接連續光源、光分配與可維修性放在材料、介面及封裝的連續證據鏈中。下列原始研究與機構資料呈現不同發展路線；此欄是教學脈絡，並非宣稱此地的發明年表。
history.textEn: This course puts external CW sources, optical distribution and serviceability within a continuous evidence chain of materials, interfaces and packaging. The primary studies and institutional records show different development routes; this is learning context, not a claimed invention timeline for this location.
